details.name: Snap.do
details.who: All Firefox users who have this add-on installed. This only applies to version 1.0 of Snap.do. Version 1.1 fixed all the issues for which this block was created.
details.why: This extension violates a number of our Add-on Guidelines, particularly on installation and settings handling. It also causes some stability problems in Firefox due to the way the toolbar is handled. Users who wish to keep the add-on enabled can enable it again in the Add-ons Manager.
